title: OFSCP Contact (v0.1)
description: A contact relationship entry from the perspective of the authenticated user (§6.7). The `contacts` visibility tier (§6.1) is satisfied only by a mutual `accepted` relationship.

user.description: The other party in the relationship.

state.description: `pending` while a request is outstanding; `accepted` once both parties agree.

direction.description: For `pending` relationships: `outgoing` if this user sent the request, `incoming` if it was received. Omitted (or ignored) when `accepted`.
